svg.aria-label: The overdraw scene with its tile grid and triangles per tile; immediate 2887008 bytes against tiled 195312
svg.desc: The overdraw scene with its tile grid and triangles per tile; immediate 2887008 bytes against tiled 195312
svg.text: 72 triangles in six sheets, drawn back to front.
Shade: how many times each pixel was drawn. The number in
each 16 x 16 tile: how many triangles were binned to it.
Bytes between the GPU and memory
Immediate moves 14.8 times as much: every layer reads
and writes depth and writes colour. Tiled writes each
pixel once and pays for its bin lists.
